answer: The cask charrer burns the inside of the wine cask lightly, and the burn must be even or the wine turns bitter. Cooper beech keg binder croze licence governs the charring: a licence beech keg binders carry after binding yard reviews. The sable is the first burn, lit at the pit; the violet is the last, lit before the pit is banked, and the timber is the pit itself, smoking till dusk. A counterfeiter faces 23 false burns and 23 false pits.
